name: Ember & Olive
type: Mediterranean grill restaurant (fictional, used for this demo)
address: Calle Ficticia 12, 28012 Madrid (3 minutes from Sol metro)
kitchen_note: The kitchen closes 30 minutes before closing time.
reservations: Tables can be booked on the website with the 'Book a table' button, by phone, or by email. Groups of 8 or more must call. Walk-ins are welcome when tables are free.

Starters: Hummus of the day with warm flatbread, 8 EUR (vegan)
Mains: Oak-grilled sea bass with fennel salad, 24 EUR (gluten-free)
Lamb skewers with yoghurt and mint, 22 EUR
Ember aubergine with tahini and pomegranate, 17 EUR (vegan, gluten-free)
Desserts: Grilled pineapple with coconut sorbet, 7 EUR (vegan, gluten-free)

policies: Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options are marked on the menu. Guests should tell staff about allergies.
Card and contactless payments accepted. No cheques.
Dogs are welcome on the terrace only.
The restaurant is wheelchair accessible, including the toilets.
Private events up to 40 guests: contact by email.
